divergences_from_approved_requirements.rationale: main.tsx is off-limits and calls createRouter with no stringifySearch override; TanStack's default JSON-encodes object-typed values, so an array yields ?assignee=%5B%22u1%22%5D. The string[] shape is derived during render and never reaches the URL boundary.

divergences_from_approved_requirements.implemented: dot separator, ?assignee=u1.u2; reader accepts BOTH dot and comma
divergences_from_approved_requirements.rationale: qss.encode() builds the query via URLSearchParams.toString(), whose form-urlencoding turns a comma into %2C, one layer below stringifySearch. Of the characters surviving unescaped (. * - _), ids are cuid2 [a-z0-9]{24} so all were collision-free; dot reads best. Caught by the P3 canary before any board wiring.

open_items.detail: No automated coverage for drag-and-drop under active filters. Manual browser pass required: filter by an assignee, drag a card between columns, confirm it stays visible and the URL is unchanged. The realtime half of AC-7 IS covered by a test.
updateLabelFilter is dead in the UI after the R-9 rewrite. Retained deliberately: still part of the hook's public return, FR-11 requires backward compatibility, and controlled-mode tests exercise it.
3 new keys exist only in i18n/en-US.json; the 16 other locales will report them missing.
Generated i18n/schema.json is stale (additionalProperties:false) until regenerated.
.sdlc/ is deliberately NOT gitignored per the Gate 0 decision, so `git add -A` will sweep run artifacts into a commit. By design; stage selectively for a code-only commit.
pnpm audit --prod reports 2 highs (nanoid, deepmerge-ts) via better-auth in apps/api; not in the web runtime. No dependency was added or changed by this run.

--before provenance calls were missed for the P2 and P5 new files and backfilled. All 10 paths are recorded with correct hashes; for those 4 new files the pre-write record was reconstructed, which is inert since they had no prior content.

bugs_found_in_preexisting_code.detail: toggleLabelGroup/clearLabelFilters looped over a per-id mutator; under the controlled model each iteration reads the same pre-change value and fires its own navigate, half-toggling a multi-id label group and creating N-1 junk history entries.
handleCloseTaskSheet navigated with an empty search object, which silently discards every active filter once filters live in the URL.
